mild: Stay close to the base prompt. Use the remix phrases as light additions. Keep the subject, setting and style of the base prompt intact.
normal: Blend the base prompt with the remix phrases. Change the setting, mood or composition noticeably, but keep the core subject of the base prompt.
wild: Diverge boldly from the base prompt. Reinterpret the subject, style and setting using the remix phrases as seeds for unexpected directions. Still produce one coherent image prompt.
